spec_match.rationale: Rule-firing readouts are read from the rendered card (getComputedStyle flexDirection and the full-description display) instead of a JS re-implementation of forceWide || w>360, so the panel can no longer claim a rule fires while the card is visibly stacked.

interactive.rationale: Two style()-flag toggles, a width slider and three preset buttons all drive the container; a ResizeObserver re-reads computed styles on every change.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises one rule firing on width OR a flag; the readouts now reflect the card's real rendering and honestly label the branch that produced any match.

edge_cases.rationale: A CSSOM capability note explains the dropped-rule case (Chromium ≤149); the observed-truth telemetry assertion holds that neither rule reports firing when the comma rule did not parse.

conformance.rationale: Aligned with the feature suite's parse/conditionText contracts.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): support note shown; after the 560px preset rule 1 state reads 'no' with label 'inactive — comma rule not parsed in this browser' (matching the stacked card — the prior false-positive is gone); force-wide toggle flips aria-pressed; the decorative add-to-cart/wishlist buttons are tabindex -1; zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow; desktop screenshot read.

telemetry_health.rationale: or-condition-rendered-truth assertion holds (no rule reports firing where the comma rule was dropped).

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables throughout; toggle active state uses accent-blue with paired ivory text.

accessibility.rationale: Added aria-pressed to both flag toggles, made the rules panel a polite live region, added a labelled width slider and preset buttons, and removed the decorative action buttons from the tab order (aria-hidden + tabindex -1).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read.

guidanceConsulted.query: toggle aria-pressed live region decorative buttons tab order width control
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Toggles need aria-pressed, status needs a live region, decorative controls should not be focusable dead ends, and width must be drivable without the resize corner.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both flag toggles got aria-pressed, the rules panel is aria-live=polite, the add-to-cart/wishlist buttons are aria-hidden + tabindex -1, and a slider plus presets drive width.

guidanceConsulted.query: read rendered container query state getComputedStyle
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Observe rendered styles rather than re-deriving breakpoint logic in JS.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Rule readouts read flexDirection and the full-description display from the card.

summary: Fixed (goal-setting pass): rule readouts now read the rendered card (ending the false 'both rules fire' while stacked), toggles expose aria-pressed, a keyboard/touch width control was added, the rules panel announces changes, and decorative buttons left the tab order. Re-verified on headless Chromium 141 (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp here): honest inactive readouts matching the stacked render, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
